name: agent-builder-roster-truthful
body: `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` must name exactly the agent roster the suite supports. It must NOT offer or generate an optional `coordinator` primary agent (no roster mention, no `### coordinator (optional)` section, no "whether a coordinator is wanted" interview bullet, no primary-mode scaffold branch, no coordinator example in the register step), and it must NOT generate `implementation-phase-reviewer` (that agent is distributed by `apg init`). Its generated set is implementers only: the core/root `implementer`, per-subsystem `<name>-implementer`s, and tiered `test-implementer`s where a test tier is file-separable. Every generated agent is scaffolded `mode: subagent` with `generated: true`. The word "coordinator" used for the codebase-navigator's ROLE in the feedback-routing/cadence prose is retained — this law forbids only the optional generated AGENT. Satisfaction is assessed by review.
